name: Kimpton La Peer Hotel
positioning: Design-led Kimpton hotel (Kimpton La Peer West Hollywood) in West Hollywood's Design District
best_for: Travelers who want a design-focused base in West Hollywood within walking distance of galleries and cafes
Guests traveling with pets of any size

facts.text: The hotel is set in West Hollywood's Design District.
L.A.-based Icelandic designer Gulla Jónsdóttir created the interiors.
The interiors mix natural materials such as concrete, leather walls and white oak flooring.
The hotel has a feather chandelier.
No Rose is a cocktail bar at the hotel.
Open-air yoga classes are hosted on the rooftop.
Pets of any size, weight or breed are welcome at no extra charge.
Rooms have a complimentary mini bar and in-room bottle service for made-to-order craft cocktails.
The hotel is within walking distance of art galleries, coffee shops and restaurants.

highlights.text: The hotel has a rooftop pickleball court.
Olive trees and a vertical garden make the pool feel secluded and intimate.
Ladyhawk, by Charbel Hayek, serves Eastern Mediterranean food with a Southern California twist.
The lobby has custom six-foot light sconces.

considerations.text: There is no in-house spa; the hotel partners with the Ole Henriksen spa at nearby Sunset Plaza.
There is no complimentary local area shuttle.
Standard rooms are somewhat small but feel bright and airy.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Kimpton La Peer Hotel
